01

Your scanner says cylinder 3 misfired.

That is a circuit, not a part. A code can be thrown by a coil, a plug, an injector, a wiring fault, or compression that is walking away. Five of those are cheap. One is not.

02

So we find out which one.

Testing, not guessing. The part that failed gets replaced, and the five that did not stay in the car — which is the difference between a repair and a parts bill.

Cylinder 3 · ignition coilReplaced. The other five stayed in the car.
